prompt: A stylized charcoal-gray alien power relay with a turquoise front plate, copper side couplings and an amber lens, standing alone on a light neutral studio background. It gently pulses with turquoise light and makes a small mechanical turn; preserve its silhouette and materials.
negative_prompt: different object, text, extra parts, camera cut, blur, flicker

control.description: 384x384 neutral gray control frame; no approved asset reference selected

workflow_input_mapping.control: the neutral image is loaded through the same node and mapping

review.observed: The approved-reference output retains the reference's chunky charcoal housing, turquoise front plate, copper side couplings, and amber lens. With the same prompt and seed but a neutral control frame, the result has a different narrow cylindrical silhouette. This is visible evidence that the image input affects the result.
limitations: This is one image-to-video comparison, not a character identity or multi-pose qualification.
The selected final frame is close to the source reference; the run does not establish useful motion or sprite readiness.
The neutral control is still an image input, so this comparison measures approved-reference influence against a neutral image condition rather than a graph with the image input disconnected.
This workflow is experimental and is not the default for image generation or character production.
